entries.description: Task 2a.1: reconcile ADRs 0024, 0025, 0027-0029 and target 6.4 with the plan and the checkout
steps: every ADR contract shape matches Tasks 2b.1-2c.9, or the plan or ADR is amended in the same commit
ADR 0028 records the DriverInput.allowed_capabilities mechanism; lineage is LineageRef(step_id, path) with one rule
stale code references in ADRs 0027, 0028 and 0029 fixed
uv run python scripts/repo_move.py check reports no broken links; full gate passes

entries.description: Task 2a.2: owner accepts ADRs 0024, 0025, 0027, 0028, 0029 and target 6.4 (gate G1)
steps: each ADR status reads Accepted with a date in the ADR and the index
2b starts only after 0027 is accepted; 2c only after 0024, 0025, 0028 and 0029

entries.description: Task 2b.1: Profile.features with off/shadow/on, default off, and the off-mode golden baseline
steps: off_mode_events.json baseline committed before any other change, with deterministic ids, and test_off_baseline_fails_on_empty_golden passes

entries.description: Task 2b.2: feature.fallback and IR event types with reason codes, rendered by ui-core
Task 2b.3: /health/ready and the evidence bundle report feature toggles
steps: export_openapi.py --check and pnpm --dir ui gen:check report no drift
full gate and make e2e pass

entries.description: Task 2c.1: TaskDefinition, AcceptanceSpec, ActionPlan, PlannedStep, LineageRef and StepRecord contracts
steps: contract tests for duplicate ids, unknown dependency, cycle and lineage ordering pass
uv run lint-imports keeps every contract

entries.description: Task 2c.2: task definitions for the eight ERP tasks, admitted by the registry
steps: test_task_capabilities_match_golden passes with a non-zero case count
registry refuses unadmitted capabilities, duplicate task ids and widening budgets; assistant definition is read-only
notes-domain task definition admitted; a pack without task definitions still loads
check_wheels.py and check_core_only.py pass; full gate passes

entries.description: Task 2c.3: action plans and step records in the memory and Postgres stores (migration 0005)
steps: store conformance tests for plans and atomic step commits pass on memory

entries.description: Task 2c.4: IR compiler, plan validation and plan digest
Task 2c.5: execution_ir shadow mode records the compiled plan and acts on the existing path
Task 2c.6: execution_ir on with single-step plans, tool set from the task definition, fallback before reservation
steps: fallback tests record feature.fallback with reason codes; ACCEPTANCE_UNMET fails the run
test_model_cannot_mark_plan_verified passes; replay suite and prompt golden pass

entries.description: Task 2c.7: multi-step plans approved once and dispatched serially with per-step verification and the live guard
steps: test_plan_approved_once_dispatches_steps_in_order passes with the VERIFYING to RUNNING pair added in this task
ERP and notes two-step scenarios pass

entries.description: Task 2c.8: plan partial failure, reconciliation and evidence sections
steps: recovery does not replay committed steps

entries.description: Task 2c.9: drivers emit ProposePlan behind the toggle
steps: replay suite replays the new plan recording; prompt golden passes; full gate passes

entries.description: Task 2d.1: end-of-phase levels 1-3, phase review and handoff
steps: full gate, Postgres run and make e2e pass on a clean tree

entries.description: Task 2d.2: owner-run live check on odoo19-learning
steps: draft-po with off, shadow and on and a read-only task with on behave as the plan's Live check says
results recorded in the handoff, labelled live
